book.name: Joŋ
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Joŋ gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Jiso bɛɛŋ Yɛlusalɛm fɛ Ŋka wu Chúŋ le
Ajiŋ ayu Jiso mɛ gɛh wu jiɛnyi nyu kimbe kì Galalee le. Wu gɛ baaŋ ka gɛɛŋ gɛ kì Judia le gɛ, nje Bajuu gɛ̀ goone ki bo yuuyɛ wu.
Kife ki Ŋka wu Bajuu wù ba gɛ̀ tɛŋe lɛ Ŋka wu Chúŋ gɛ̀ bee ki too wa mbebe le.
Booŋ ba bwe Jiso mo bo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Jâ yanɛ wo gɛ̂ɛŋ Judia lɛ bamii buŋ ba ŋgoo yɛŋ lɛme chi wo lɛne le.
Muh nɛ lɛne lɛme wu goone lɛ bamii kɛɛ wu, wu gɛ ya wu lɛne nyilɛ le gɛ. No wo gee mwɛɛ munɛ, wo gɛ̂ɛŋ wo dûnyɛ kikwɛɛ kuŋ woŋ le.”
Booŋ ba bwee baa gɛ̀ jɛme noo nje bo gɛ̀ baaŋ leesɛ gɛ muntele muboo yi ye ye le gɛ.
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Kife kaŋ baaŋ a to gɛ. Fɛ bɛŋ le le kife kena to ki nyu ki kojɛ ka.
Gɛ bamii ba le ba yi woŋ kfunɛ le taŋlo bo banɛ bɛŋ gɛ. Geenɛ, bo banɛ mɛ nje njɛme bo le kune gee chiboo chì befe.
Bɛŋ bɛ̂ɛne fiena bɛŋ gɛɛne fɛ ŋka le. Gɛ mbɛɛŋ yo gɛ. Kife kaŋ baaŋ a to gɛ ki kojɛ gɛ.”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu mɛ gɛh Galalee.
Geenɛ, sege booŋ ba bwee gɛ̀ bɛnɛ wa fɛ Ŋka wɛɛ le, wu gɛ̀ shɛɛ wu bɛɛŋ tɛ yo. Wu doo wu bɛɛne, wu bɛɛne bamii yɛde gɛ wu le gɛ, wu bɛɛne fie nyu nyilɛ le.
Fi gɛ̀ bee Bajuu goone wa wu fɛ Ŋka wɛɛ le, bo biide lɛ, “Wu le faaŋ mbɛŋ?”
Bamii gɛ̀ ja bo tu bo chuune kune wu baaŋ. Bamu bɛɛŋse lɛ, “Wu le muh wù joŋe.” Bamu kaji lo lɛ, “Wu lɛɛde lo bɛ bamii.”
Geenɛ, muh gɛ̀ baaŋ nyu gɛ yu wu le wu jɛmɛ kune wu fɛ waaŋ gɛ, nje bo gɛ faane bikwɛɛ bi Bajuu.
Jiso yɛyɛ bamii fɛ Ŋka le
Aju a Ŋka gɛ̀ gade wa antɛnɛɛ, Jiso gɛɛŋ wu lee fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le wu yɛyi bamii.
Bikwɛɛ bi Bajuu tu bi yuge bi kɛme lo ŋgha, bi maŋe lɛ, “Muh wunɛ jiɛnyi nɛɛ fɛ wu tu wu kee mwɛɛ nɛ njɛ wu gɛ yɛyɛ wa Ŋwa wu Nyo sɛŋ.”
Jiso mo wu ja wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ n'yɛyɛ wu n'yɛyi wunɛ nyu waŋ gɛ. Le wu muh wu tuŋ mɛ.
Muh nɛ goone ki wù gee nyu fiɛɛ fì Nyo goone, wu mo wu kɛɛ lɛ laa n'yɛyɛ wunɛ jade nyu fɛ Nyo le noo, n'yɛyi a bvuŋga bwaŋ le la.
Muh wù jɛme nyu a bvuŋga bwe le to wu gôone mbɛɛŋsɛ nyu fɛ kikwɛɛ ke le. Geenɛ muh wù goone jee chì kuge nyu chi muh wù tuŋ wu to nyu muh wu nchiɛɛŋ, chimbiaŋ nyu gɛ yi ye ye le gɛ.
Musɛ gɛ̀ nya gɛ banchi bɛŋ le? Geenɛ, gɛ muh mu bɛŋ le gɛɛde banchi baa gɛ! Bɛŋ goone ki bɛŋ yûuyɛ mɛ nje la?”

content: Bamii baa chvuu wu le lɛ, “Wo kɛmɛ nchɛndaa wu debele yi ye yo le. Muh wù goone ki wu yûuyɛ wo le yɛɛŋ?”
Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Ŋgɛ̀ ŋge lɛme chimimia bɛŋ tu bɛŋ kɛme lo ŋgha kune chi.
Musɛ gɛ nya nchi lɛ bɛŋ chvûse booŋ yeh. Gɛ nchi wunɛ gɛ̀ bu mo nyu a Musɛ le gɛ. Wu gɛ̀ bu nyu a bachiji bena le. Bɛŋ mo bɛŋ tu bɛŋ chvuse booŋ yeh mo nyu juu chi yuuŋ.
Nɛ ba chvuse muh ye juu chi yuuŋ keefɛ bo ŋgôde nchi wu Musɛ lɛ gɛ, bɛŋ tu bɛŋ yuge nsaasɛ bɛ mɛ lɛ nle nfɛ muh wu tɛmɛ ye yichii juu chi yuuŋ nje la?
Keefɛ bɛŋ sâge nsa bɛŋ suune bɛŋ baaŋ ya taa gɛ bɛŋ yɛŋ gɛ. Bɛŋ sâge a je yì kooji le.”

content: Bamii tu bo maŋe laa Jiso le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka la
Bamii ba Yɛlusalɛm bamu mo bo ja bo biih lɛ, “Wunɛ le gɛ muh wu ba goone lɛ ba yuuyɛ?
Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ nɛ wu wunɛ fɛnɛ wu jɛme wu chuunyi fɛ waaŋ njɛ muh jɛme fiɛɛ wu le sɛŋ. Taŋlo nyu lɛ bikwɛɛ bi woŋ le bi kɛɛ wa chuule lɛ muh wunɛ le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka?
Geenɛ, besabɛŋ kee a muh wunɛ ja yo. Sege Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka lé wu gê wu tô gɛ muh nyu wu gê wu kɛ̂ɛ a wu ja yo gɛ.”
Noo, Jiso gɛ̀ doo wu yɛyi bamii fɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le wu ja wu jaŋ fɛwɛɛwe lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ kee mɛ, bɛŋ kee tɛ a nja yo. Geenɛ, gɛ nto fɛnɛ a bvuŋga bwaŋ le gɛ. Muh wù tuŋ mɛ le muh wù nchiɛɛŋ, bɛŋ ya kee gɛ wu gɛ.
Ŋkee wu nje nja fɛ wu le, le wu wù tuŋ mɛ.”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo, bamii bamu mo bo tu bo goone ki bo koo wu. Geenɛ, muh gɛ̀ baaŋ kuŋ gɛ wu le gɛ, nje kife ke gɛ̀ baaŋ a to gɛ ki kojɛ gɛ.
Geenɛ, bamii ba duude leesɛ muntele yi ye ye le bo tu bo duu lɛ, “Sege Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka lé wu gê wu tô, taŋlo wu ka wu ge mwɛɛ mu duunyi bvukugɛ bvu Nyo fede muh mu wunɛ ge wa?”
Ba tuŋ bamii ba nchi lɛ bo gɛɛŋ bo koo Jiso
Bafalashii gɛ̀ doo bo yu no kinchvu ki bamii lɛ chuune kune Jiso, bɛ bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ mo bo tuŋ bamii ba nchi lɛ bo gɛɛŋ bo koo wu.
No bo gɛnɛ, Jiso jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Nlé nyûme besabɛŋ gɛh yi kife le nɛ shige, mɛ mo ŋkaasɛ ntu jiŋ fɛ muh wù tuŋ mɛ le.
Bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gê bɛŋ shɛ̂ɛ bɛŋ gôoŋ mɛ nɛ, bɛŋ gɛ ka bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ mɛne gɛ. Fɛ ŋgɛɛne fo gɛ taŋlo bɛŋ tô fo gɛ.”

content: Bajuu jɛmɛ bikwɛɛ biboo le lɛ, “Muh wunɛ goone ki wu gɛ̂ɛŋ nyu faane fɛ besabɛŋ lé be gê be gôoŋ wu bee gɛ ka be yɛ̂ŋ wu le gɛ? Wu goone ki wu gɛ̂ɛŋ nyu a bituŋ bi bamii besa gɛ̀ saaŋe bo gɛɛŋ bo tu bo chee bi le, wu gɛɛŋ wu yɛyi bamii ba bituŋ bi yo le?
Fiɛɛ fì wu duu lɛ,

content.text: ‘Bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gê bɛŋ gôoŋ mɛ bɛŋ gɛ ka bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ mɛne gɛ, fɛ ŋgɛɛne fo gɛ taŋlo bɛŋ tô fo gɛ’,

content: wu jɛmɛ fi nyu lɛ la?”
Jiso ka bamii bɛ joo yì nyaa kinche
Lɛ to nyu juu chi Ŋka chi fɛkimɛsɛ chì gɛ̀ bee juu chi Ŋka wɛɛ chi baaŋ, Jiso gɛ ja wu lɛɛŋ we wu jaŋ lɛ,

content.text: “Nɛ kindoŋ yune muh, mwɛdɛ to fɛ mɛne wu mu fiɛɛ.
Muh wù le wu leesɛ fitele ye yaŋ le, fi lé fi nyû gɛh no Ŋwa wu Nyo jɛmɛ lɛ, ‘Joo yì nyaa kinche lé yi gê yi bûde a fitele fie le yi bohge nɛ kokokokoko.’”

content: Finɛ fiɛɛ Jiso gɛ̀ jɛme nyu kune Kiyo kì bamii ba gɛ̀ leesɛ fitele yi ye ye le lɛ bo lé bo gê bo kɛ̂mɛ. Gɛ̀ bee kife kinɛ le ba baaŋ a nya gɛ Kiyo kiyu bo le gɛ, nje Jiso gɛ̀ bee ba baaŋ a yuusɛ gɛ wa wu, ki wu lêe bvukugɛ le gɛ.
Bamii tɛɛnyɛ kune Jiso
Bamii yu fiɛɛ finɛ fì Jiso gɛ jɛme, bamu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Muh wunɛ le Muh wu Ntuŋ wù Nyo wɛɛ.”
Bamu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Wunɛ le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka.” Geenɛ, bamu biih fiboo lɛ, “Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka gɛ̀ kɛme ki wu bû nyu Galalee?
Gɛ Ŋwa wu Nyo jɛme lɛ Mbvusɛ wɛɛ lé wu gê wu bû nyu a kfuu chi Nfoŋ Dabi le, ntɛ wu Bɛtɛhɛm le, wu le ntɛ wu Dabi le?”
No bamii jɛmɛ noo, kiŋgaye mo ki to a bo antɛnɛɛ kune Jiso.
Bamii bamu bo le tu bo goone ki bo koo wu, geenɛ muh gɛ̀ baaŋ kuŋ gɛ wu le gɛ.
Bikwɛɛ bi Bajuu faŋ Jiso
Bamii ba nchi baa mo bo ja, bo kaasɛ bo tu jiŋ fɛ bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ le bɛ Bafalashii, bo biih bamii ba nchi baa le lɛ, “Bɛŋ baaŋ bɛ wu to gɛ nje la?”
Bamii ba nchi baa chvuu bo le lɛ, “Muh gɛ̀ baaŋ a yu gɛ wu jɛme gɛh njɛ muh wunɛ gɛ.”
Bafalashii biih bo le lɛ, “Wu le wu gɛɛŋ wa wu lɛɛ tɛ mo bɛ bɛŋ fo?
Bɛŋ le bɛŋ yɛŋ bikwɛɛ bi woŋ, kɛnɛ Bafalashii leesɛ fitele yi ye ye le?
Le gɛ kinchvu kinɛ ki ya kee gɛ nchi wù Nyo gɛ. Loŋ le fɛ bo fwa.”
Nikodɛmu wù gɛ̀ bee muh mu ŋgoo yi Bafalashii le, wu gɛ̀ gɛɛŋ wa juu chimi wu yɛŋ Jiso le, wu gɛ̀ bee fo. Wu biih bo le lɛ,
“Nchi wese besabɛŋ le wu bɛɛŋ lɛ ba suune nsa wu muh ba baaŋ yegɛ gɛ ba yu fiɛɛ fì wu jɛme le gɛ?”
Bo mo bo biih wu le lɛ, “Wo ja tɛ Galalee le? Talɛ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le chuule wo yɛŋ lɛ gɛ taŋlo muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo wumu yu wu to wu bu Galalee la.”
[Bo mo bo jade wu mumwaa mumwaa bo tuu yéh yiboo le.
